name: Laderas del Genil

known.via: English Wikipedia "Laderas del Genil" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: An Andalusian vino de la tierra in the southwest of Granada province, formerly called Granada Sur-Oeste.
